info.name: Meeting Room Microservices — Complete Test Suite
info.description:
Enterprise-grade Postman collection for the Meeting Room Booking microservices system.

### 🚀 Quick Start Workflow
1. Go to **0. Auth & Keycloak** -> run **Login as User** (saves `{{user_token}}`).
2. Run **Login as Admin** (saves `{{admin_token}}`).
3. Go to **1. Room Service** -> **Admin Operations** -> run **Create Room** (saves `{{room_id}}`).
4. Go to **2. Booking Service** -> run **Create Booking** (automatically sets valid tomorrow dates, creates booking, saves `{{booking_id}}`, and publishes `BookingCreatedEvent` to RabbitMQ!).
5. Test cancellation, admin listing, business rule edge cases, Gateway rate limiting, and discovery.
